wikipedia.title: Rei (given name)
wikipedia.noteJa: 英語版記事の聖書人物項目は、アドニヤの即位計画に加わらずダビデに忠実だったイスラエル人レイを説明しています。
wikipedia.verifiedHeadingOrText: The biblical paragraph identifies Rei as the Israelite who remained loyal to David during Adonijah’s usurpation, matching the person named in 1 Kings 1:8.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and the mighty men who belonged to David, were not with Adonijah.
